languageModelTools.name: bigraph-context
languageModelTools.description: Shows which bigraph file is currently active and lists all open bigraph editor tabs. Call this first when unsure which file you are working on.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Shows which bigraph file is currently active and lists all open bigraph editor tabs. Call this first when unsure which file you are working on.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-summary
languageModelTools.description: Returns a quick statistical overview of a bigraph: total nodes, roots, sites, hyperedges, edges, list of control types, and maximum nesting depth.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a statistical overview of a bigraph: total nodes, roots, sites, hyperedges, edges, control types, and maximum nesting depth. Use this to understand the structure at a glance.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute path to a specific bigraph file. If omitted, uses the currently active editor tab.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getRoots
languageModelTools.description: Returns all root regions of the bigraph (top-level containers in the place graph). Each root has an id, label, and child count.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all root regions of the bigraph place graph. Each root has an id, label, and child count.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute path to a specific bigraph file.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getChildren
languageModelTools.description: Returns the direct children of a node in the place graph. Each child includes id, type, label, controlType, and childCount.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the direct children of a node in the bigraph place graph. Each child includes id, type, label, controlType, and childCount.

nodeId.description: The GModel ID of the parent node.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getNodeInfo
languageModelTools.description: Returns detailed information about a single node: type, label, controlType, parent, children, connected edges, args.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns detailed information about a single bigraph node: type, label, controlType, parent, children, connected edges, and args.

nodeId.description: The GModel ID of the node.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-findByControl
languageModelTools.description: Finds all nodes with a given control type (e.g. Sensor, Room, Router). Returns id, label, child count.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Finds all bigraph nodes with a given control type (e.g. Sensor, Room, Router). Returns id, label, and child count for each match.

control.description: The control type name to search for.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getSignature
languageModelTools.description: Returns all available control types with their arity and kind (ACTIVE/PASSIVE/ATOMIC). Use this to know which controlName values are valid when creating new nodes.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all available control types in the bigraph signature with their arity and kind (ACTIVE/PASSIVE/ATOMIC). Use to discover valid controlName values before creating nodes.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute path to a specific bigraph file.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addControl
languageModelTools.description: Adds a new control to the bigraph signature (writes companion .signature files and reloads the model). Use before bigraph-addNode when the needed control type does not exist yet.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Adds a control to the dynamic signature with a name, non-negative integer arity, and optional kind ATOMIC (default), ACTIVE, or PASSIVE. Persists signature and reloads the diagram.

name.description: Name of the new control (should be unique in the signature).

arity.description: Link arity (number of ports) for this control.

filePath.description: Optional. Absolute path to the bigraph .xmi file.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getLinks
languageModelTools.description: Returns all hyperedges (links) in the bigraph. Each link includes id, name, and connected node IDs.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all hyperedges (links) in the bigraph link graph. Each link includes id, name, and the IDs of connected nodes.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-getNeighbors
languageModelTools.description: Returns all nodes connected to a given node via shared hyperedges in the link graph.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all bigraph nodes connected to a given node via shared hyperedges in the link graph.

nodeId.description: The GModel ID of the node.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addNode
languageModelTools.description: Creates a new bigraph node with a given control type as a child of an existing node, root, or site.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new bigraph node with a given control type as a child of an existing node, root, or site. The controlName must exist in the signature.

parentId.description: The GModel ID of the parent (root, node, or site).

controlName.description: The control type name for the new node (must exist in the signature).

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addSite
languageModelTools.description: Creates a bigraph site (hole in the place graph). Parent is resolved from default position.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a bigraph site (place-graph hole). The site is placed under a root or node.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addInnerName
languageModelTools.description: Creates an inner name in the link graph. Use createEdge to connect it to nodes or outer names.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates an inner name (link-graph internal interface). Connect it with createEdge.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addOuterName
languageModelTools.description: Creates an outer name in the link graph. Use createEdge to connect nodes or inner names to it.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates an outer name (link-graph external interface). Connect it with createEdge.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-addEdge
languageModelTools.description: Creates a new hyperedge (link) in the bigraph. Use createEdge to connect nodes or names to it.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new hyperedge (link). Then use createEdge to connect points to this link.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-deleteElement
languageModelTools.description: Deletes a bigraph element (node, site, root, hyperedge, or edge). Supports undo.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a bigraph element (node, site, root, hyperedge, or edge) by its GModel ID. The operation supports undo.

elementId.description: The GModel ID of the element to delete.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-createEdge
languageModelTools.description: Creates a link connection between two elements (e.g. node port to hyperedge, or inner to outer name).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a link connection between two bigraph elements (e.g. node port to hyperedge, or inner name to outer name).

sourceId.description: GModel ID of the source element.

targetId.description: GModel ID of the target element.

languageModelTools.name: bigraph-autoLayout
languageModelTools.description: Runs automatic layout (ELK) on the diagram. Optionally specify algorithm: layered, mrtree, force, stress.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs automatic layout (ELK) on the bigraph diagram. Optionally specify an algorithm: layered, mrtree, force, or stress.

algorithm.description: Optional. One of: layered, mrtree, force, stress.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.compile:all: npm run compile:webview && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
